title: Verify deleting a template that is a customer default drops the default link but keeps existing work-order fees/discounts
custom_preconds: 1. A template "ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Discount" is a default on the customer AND has been auto-added to an existing OPEN work order.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts and delete a template that is a customer default (confirm).
2. Open the customer's Fees & Discounts tab.
3. Open a work order that already has a fee/discount made from that template.
custom_expected:
1. The template is deleted from the library.
2. The customer's default link to it is removed (the tab count goes down).
3. The existing work order's fee/discount stays unchanged.
